description: Full detail for one slide: overview, why it matters to executives and consultants, how it is typically used, all tags, preview image URL, the parent template (with purchase and subscription options), the other slides in that template, and related slides from other templates. Takes the slide_id from search_slides (numeric ID preferred; a slide slug also works).

slide_id.description: Numeric slide ID (e.g. "571") or slide slug (e.g. "pmesii-pt-strategic-framework").
